cases.why: CHANGED DELIBERATELY on 2026-09-18, and this case is the record of it: it used to pin «skip», because 5411 is on the obvious list and the gate never read the note. That was the defect the eval found (`note-says-salary`), not a design — a note is the one unambiguous human sentence about a row, so it now overrides every skip, capped at 40 calls a day. The price is visible in the same report: the ask rate went 74% → 76%

the other half of the override: a note the user opened and left blank is NOT a note. Without the trim, every row touched by the editor would buy a Sonnet call — and this case is on an obvious MCC precisely so the two answers differ
§LANG: the note is English and the row is Ukrainian — the category must not follow the language
